text:
Sam (CEO): quick pulse for the week — 3 priority asks and a few ops notes. please read and react.
Sam (CEO): 1) Privacy policy: default data retention will move to 90d for hosted API; legal and product to finalise customer messaging by Friday.
Sam (CEO): 2) Private GA: target internal rollout next Wed, external invites begin the following week. product+eng: make sure the onboarding checklist is green.
Sam (CEO): 3) Reliability: incident on staging yesterday (memory leak in batching path) caused degraded latency during a canary. rollback happened, no customer impact. SRE to run postmortem.
Sam (CEO): metrics snapshot: p50 latency down 12% vs last week, cost/token -3%. good momentum but need stability on long tails.
Priya - VP Product: ack. I'll draft the customer-facing note for privacy and work with Hana for legal signoff. will link doc here when ready.
Priya - VP Product: for Private GA — we need a small checklist item: telemetry toggle + KMS keys confirm. Diego, can your team own the telemetry toggle by Tue EOD?
Diego - Eng Lead: can do. PRs: #4821 (telemetry toggle) and #4822 (kv-cache fix). the batching memory fix is in #4822, unit tests added. planning canary redeploy tomorrow morning.
Morgan (SRE): incident summary: staging canary hit OOM due to an edge case in continuous batching with long prefix sequences. rolled back to tag v1.23.4 at 02:10 UTC. no prod impact. postmortem scheduled Thu 16:00 UTC in #incidents — please add any notes. runbook updated: https://redir.runbooks/retry-batching-oom (internal).
Alex - Head of Sales: flagged — several pilot customers asked about Private GA timeline. If we open invites next week, we need a 1-paragraph summary for customer outreach. Priya/Hana — can we get that by Mon?
Hana (Legal): reviewing the privacy wording. prefer "90 days by default, opt-in for extended retention" language. need final approval by Friday COB to sync with marketing.
deploy-bot: deployment v1.23.4 -> v1.24.0 rollback initiated by Morgan (SRE) at 02:10 UTC. logs: "ROLLBACK OK - mem_pressure_detected".
Diego - Eng Lead: noted. can we make the canary window a bit longer (30m -> 2h) for future updates? also request additional health checks around kv-cache misses.
Sam (CEO): good catches. Diego and Morgan — please coordinate the extended canary and add a brief note in the rollout template so we don't skip it.
Sam (CEO): two quick asks to org: A) surface any blocker that would prevent Private GA invites by EOD Monday. B) if you're on the postmortem invite list and can't attend, add notes to the doc beforehand.
Priya - VP Product: I'll own the GA readiness board and ping owners tomorrow at 09:30 PT.
Alex - Head of Sales: will prepare a customer one-pager draft and share by Mon noon.
Hana (Legal): I'll post redline suggestions in the policy doc by Thu AM.
Morgan (SRE): postmortem link and dial-in in #incidents. requesting Diego, infra, and one on-call dev to join.
Sam (CEO): thanks everyone. small, focused week — keep updates in this thread or ping me directly for escalations. :thumbsup:
__comments: Single-thread Slack conversation; messages are short and in chronological order. No title field per agents.md.
